title: How Does Walmart Make $6.4 Billion From Ads?
description:
Walmart's ad business, the sponsored spots in its app and site that brands pay for, made about $6.4 billion last year and grew 37% in the U.S. this fall.
#walmart #retailmedia #money #shorts

Sources: Walmart Q3 FY2027 earnings release via Business Wire/Finviz (Nov 19, 2026); Walmart Q3 FY2027 earnings call via The Motley Fool (Nov 19, 2026); PPC Land (Nov 2026; Feb 22, 2026); Supermarket News (Nov 2026); Digital Commerce 360 (Feb 23, 2026); Marketing Dive and AdExchanger (2026); Digiday/Modern Retail (Oct 13, 2025)
Photos: Walmart Corporate, Rusty Clark, Clean Wal-Mart, Mike Mozart/JeepersMedia (CC BY, Flickr)
first_comment: Be honest: do you tap the first result, or scroll past the sponsored ones? 👇

scenes.say: Walmart made {$6.4 billion|six point four billion dollars} last year from ads.
scenes.source: PPC Land Feb 22 2026 ('Walmart's global advertising business grew 46% to nearly $6.4 billion in FY26'); Digital Commerce 360 Feb 23 2026 (Rainey: advertising up 46% globally to $6.4 billion); Marketing Dive + AdExchanger 2026 ($6.4B). Fiscal 2026 ended Jan 31 2026.

scenes.say: Not groceries. Brands paying to reach you.
scenes.source: Walmart Connect sells ads to brands and sellers (walmartconnect.com; Walmart Marketplace sponsored search guide)

scenes.say: Search paper towels in the app, and some top results say sponsored.
scenes.source: Digiday / Modern Retail Oct 13 2025 ('Walmart.com's search results put ads front and center'); Walmart Connect sponsored search places sponsored products in search results (marketplacelearn.walmart.com)

scenes.say: Brands paid for that spot, right where you tap.
scenes.source: Walmart Connect sponsored search: advertisers pay for placement in search results

scenes.say: The twist? Walmart's finance chief says without ads, its online store is only around break-even.
scenes.source: CFO John David Rainey, Q3 FY2027 call Nov 19 2026: 'we are actually getting to a point where we are pretty close to break-even without advertising' (PPC Land Nov 2026); The Motley Fool transcript summary: 'the U.S. e-commerce business is approaching break-even profitability when excluding advertising revenue'

scenes.say: And Walmart's U.S. ad business grew {37%|thirty seven percent} this fall.
scenes.source: Walmart Q3 FY2027 release Nov 19 2026 via Finviz ('Walmart U.S. advertising up 37%'); Supermarket News Nov 2026; PPC Land Nov 2026 (quarter ended Oct 31 2026, includes VIZIO and Vibe)

scenes.say: It's called retail media: selling your attention to the brands on the shelf.
scenes.source: Industry term 'retail media' (Walmart Connect is Walmart's retail media business; Digiday 2025); no figure
